# Check: Ticker in four languages (ticker.allomos.com)

1. Open https://ticker.allomos.com in a private window. It follows your browser's language (Japanese, Simplified or Traditional Chinese, otherwise English).
2. At the foot of the page, pick each language in turn: every text on the page, the tab title, numbers and dates change with it. Reload: the choice stays.
3. Sign in in Japanese (or Chinese): the sign-in email arrives in that language, and a brand-new account's first list is named in it (ウォッチリスト, 自选股, 自選股).
4. Open a list and a ticker page in each language on your phone: nothing is in mixed languages (company names from the data provider stay in English), and the chart range buttons fit on one line.
